title: Proof of efficacy of the GenE³ app to support patients with hereditary breast and ovarian cancer during the genetic counseling process
summary: The aim of the study is to show that the GenE³ app improves the care of patients. We expect that the GenE³ app will improve users’ knowledge and understanding of their health. At the same time, we do not expect that using the GenE³ app will increase users’ psychological burden.
conditions: Family history of malignant neoplasm of breast
